patch_description: Favor the particle whose position plus damped velocity lies closest to the refreshed swarm best. This distinguishes approaching trajectories from outward motion and penalizes overshoot without relying on personal-best rank. The 0.73 factor approximates inertia damping; this is a geometric proxy, not a prediction of the full stochastic PSO update. Syntax and finite deterministic outputs passed focused checks; performance remains unmeasured.
